machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory
purpose: Measure the paging and host-work assumptions in plan-3-speedup.md before selecting the next optimization.

text_encoder.interpretation: Whole-file WILLNEED is not a cheap asynchronous hint on this run: the four calls consumed 7.622 seconds, yet first use still stalled at the embedding and shard transitions. Selective decoder-layer ranges are worth an A/B; merely moving no-copy buffer creation after compilation cannot matter because buffer creation was 1 ms and compilation was 5 ms.

cached_transformer_block.interpretation: The first MPS block pays a one-time cold-start penalty. Steady blocks are GPU-bound: metadata lookup is 0-1 ms, MPS object construction rounds to 0 ms, and block wall time is within 0-1 ms of GPU time. Prebuilding descriptors remains sensible cleanup but is bounded by the existing whole-loop wall-minus-GPU gap (about 0.5 s with Cache-DiT), not the multi-second estimate.

profiling_controls.text_timing: Always emitted with the existing per-layer progress lines.
profiling_controls.cached_block_timing: Set QI_PROFILE_CACHED_BLOCK=1; only blocks 0, 1, and 31 of step 2 are printed.
